episodes.title: Air: Part 1
episodes.summary: When a secret military research base is attacked, a small group of civilians and military personnel escape through the Stargate to a ship that is locked on course through deep space.

episodes.title: Air: Part 2
episodes.summary: A soldier leads evacuees through a stargate onto an unknown, but somewhat familiar spacecraft.

episodes.title: Air: Part 3
episodes.summary: The air is running out on the Destiny and a solution is sought on a desolate planet.

episodes.title: Darkness
episodes.summary: When the Destiny suffers a complete loss of power, they hope a nearby planet is habitable.

episodes.title: Light
episodes.summary: Unable to avoid a collision course with a star, a lottery is held to decide who gets to abandon ship.

episodes.title: Water
episodes.summary: Col. Young and Lt. Scott search a frozen planet for much needed water, while those aboard the Destiny track down an intruder.

episodes.title: Earth
episodes.summary: A high-risk operation could conceivably return everyone trapped on board the Destiny to Earth, but not without risking their lives.

episodes.title: Time
episodes.summary: The crew recovers one of their Kinos from a newly discovered jungle planet and finds it filled with data.

episodes.title: Life
episodes.summary: While Scott and Wray use the stones to visit loved ones back on Earth, the crew exploration of the Destiny turns up a startling discovery.

episodes.title: Justice
episodes.summary: When the body of a crew member is discovered, the crew must deal with the fact that there is a murderer in their midst.

episodes.title: Space
episodes.summary: A transmission glitch with the communication stones sends Col. Young's consciousness somewhere far from Earth.

episodes.title: Divided
episodes.summary: While Col. Young and Lt. Scott explore the ship's hull for an Alien-tracking device a growing divide among the crew threatens the current command structure aboard Destiny.

episodes.title: Faith
episodes.summary: When Destiny abruptly drops out of FTL, Dr. Rush is at a loss to explain the sudden appearance of a lone planet orbiting an uncharted star.

episodes.title: Human
episodes.summary: Dr. Nicholas Rush attempts to navigate the Destiny's core systems using the neural interface in hopes of finding the key to take control of the ship before the interface itself kills him.

episodes.title: Lost
episodes.summary: Unable to make it back to the gate before the Destiny jumped to FTL, the team is left stranded.

episodes.title: Sabotage
episodes.summary: Without the means to alter the Destiny's course, Dr. Rush calculates the Destiny will fall short of making it to the next galaxy, stranding them indefinitely.

episodes.title: Pain
episodes.summary: Members of the Destiny crew begin experiencing disturbingly real hallucinations.

episodes.title: Subversion
episodes.summary: Dr. Rush becomes embroiled in a risky plan to expose a mole inside Homeworld Command.

episodes.title: Incursion: Part 1
episodes.summary: The Lucian Alliance forces Dr. Rush to help them stage an assault on the Destiny.

episodes.title: Incursion: Part 2
episodes.summary: The Destiny crew must fight for their lives when members of the Lucian Alliance come through the Stargate, bent on taking the ship by force.

episodes.title: Intervention
episodes.summary: Control of the Destiny hangs in the balance as the battle continues between the crew and the Lucian Alliance.

episodes.title: Aftermath
episodes.summary: With food and water supplies running dangerously low and tempers flaring, a shuttle is deployed to an unstable planet whose Stargate has been locked out of Destiny's controls.

episodes.title: Awakening
episodes.summary: The crew encounters a ship, similar in ancient design to Destiny, which may provide the means to return to Earth.

episodes.title: Pathogen
episodes.summary: The Destiny crew grows concerned when Chloe's unusual behavior reveals possible Alien influence.

episodes.title: Cloverdale
episodes.summary: While investigating a planet with his team, Lt. Scott is infected by an alien organism that affects both his mind and body.

episodes.title: Trial and Error
episodes.summary: A series of realistic visions cause Col. Young to question his ability as commander of Destiny.

episodes.title: The Greater Good
episodes.summary: Dr. Rush and Col. Young are stranded aboard an alien ship.

episodes.title: Malice
episodes.summary: Lucian Alliance prisoner Simeon escapes, creating a manhunt on a remote planet.

episodes.title: Visitation
episodes.summary: Crewmembers left behind on a seemingly ideal world over a year earlier make a mysterious return.

episodes.title: Resurgence
episodes.summary: All is not as it seems when Destiny follows a remote energy signature that leads them to a sea of damaged and lifeless ships.

episodes.title: Deliverance
episodes.summary: Locked in a battle with a Drone Command Ship, the Destiny is surprised by the arrival of the Aliens that abducted Rush and Chloe.

episodes.title: Twin Destinies
episodes.summary: Excitement spreads through the ship as Eli believes he's found a way to dial Earth, only Dr. Rush has serious reservations about the plan and abandoning Destiny.

episodes.title: Alliances
episodes.summary: An attack on Homeworld Command traps Greer and Wray.

episodes.title: Hope
episodes.summary: Another consciousness finds it's way into Chloe's body through the stones, while Volker succumbs to an illness Tamara may not be able to treat.

episodes.title: Seizure
episodes.summary: Homeworld Command tries to convince an ally they suspect might be infiltrated by the Lucian Alliance to let them use their planet to dial Destiny. Meanwhile Rush is trapped in a simulation created by Amanda Perry.

episodes.title: The Hunt
episodes.summary: While exploring a planet the team is attacked and members taken captive by an alien creature.

episodes.title: Common Descent
episodes.summary: Destiny discovers the survivors of an interplanetary expedition who claim their civilization, Novus, was founded two thousand years earlier by Destiny's crew.

episodes.title: Epilogue
episodes.summary: Returning the settlers to their home planet Novus, the Destiny crew discover the planet has been abandoned and on the verge of seismic destruction.

episodes.title: Blockade
episodes.summary: Alien drones create a blockade of viable power sources forcing Destiny to recharge in a star so hot it could destroy the ship.

episodes.title: Gauntlet
episodes.summary: Blocked by Command Ships at every star and unable to gate for supplies without alerting the drones, Destiny must take a stand or be left adrift.
